features: Powerful Wi-Fi Coverage with 5 dBi Antennas Enjoy seamless Wi-Fi coverage across your home or office, thanks to 2 high-gain 5 dBi Wi-Fi antennas and 2 LTE antennas. Ideal for eliminating dead zones and providing stable internet to up to 32 devices

Plug & Play SIM-Based Internet No technician needed! Just insert your SIM card and power on to get instant SIM internet perfect for homes, remote offices, shops, or even pop-up events. No messy cables, no complicated setup.

Enterprise-Grade Security, Now at Home Your network stays protected with cutting-edge WPA3 encryption and EN 303 645 cyber security certification. Block threats, secure devices, and browse with peace of mind

Smart Failover for Uninterrupted Connectivity Switches automatically to mobile internet if your wired broadband fails so you're always online, no matter what. Built-in WAN failover keeps business and entertainment going without disruption.

Versatile & Built for All Use-Cases From smart classrooms and home offices to remote stores, the G403C is designed for high-performance connectivity in any environment. Includes 3 LAN ports, 1 WAN port, and a user-friendly web interface for full control.
